key_provisions_or_claims: Adopts a multiannual DOSES R&D programme on statistical expert systems
Community budget of ECU 4 million, including one staff member
Part I coordinated projects and Part II shared-cost projects with four themes
Commission executes the programme, assisted by an advisory committee of Member State representatives
Review in the second year and a final evaluation reported to Parliament and Council
annotation.summary_en: 1989 European Commission re-examined proposal for a Council Decision establishing the DOSES programme, a multiannual R&D programme on statistical expert systems with ECU 4 million funding. It sets out coordinated and shared-cost projects, committee oversight, and review. It has no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
annotation.title_clean: Re-examined proposal for a Council Decision instituting a specific multiannual programme for the research and development of statistical expert systems (DOSES)
